baseline.source_authority: G4-07 Source Authorization and Bounds Rev0.1: /sys/class/dmi/id selected readable files; D0, allowlisted public DMI files only, maximum 64 entries, 4 MiB, 3s, no sudo/dmidecode/secret sources
baseline.source_worker_contract: Accepted G5-03 passive_worker.py emits acquired records in deterministic sorted allowlisted order; parent writes original bytes as item0001..itemNNNN and persists successful source_paths in that same order
provenance_decisions: CP-01 D-03 truthfully evidenced parser status
CP-01 D-04 same-run evidence binding and immutability
FR-121 raw evidence pointer excluded from public outputs

independent_review.method: Source-first oracle specification written before CP-03 increment-04 parser code. Expected outcomes are derived from approved G4-07 and accepted G5-03 original worker/receipt mechanics rather than parser output.
independent_review.reasoning_independence: Separate derivation, same AI assistant; NOT independently human-reviewed
independent_review.approval_boundary: No new owner approval of detailed externally published field vocabulary or G5-04 gate is implied

canonical_private_mapping: platform.dmi.<exact_allowlisted_attribute>; interpreted identifier from verified receipt source path; raw content never determines attribute identity; private only

tests.precondition: Two sealed items from SRC-04, receipt source_paths are permitted exact DMI paths in sorted worker order; evidence IDs and SHA-256 valid
tests.expected: One raw fallback plus one typed STRING per item; datum_path attributed to the corresponding path, with each semantic evidence_refs equal to that item's original ID and matching same-run attempt ID; validate_canonical succeeds

tests.precondition: One optional DMI attribute absent and excluded from sealed evidence, other paths and receipts remain aligned
tests.expected: No synthesized attribute; reported unavailable_fields retained with no semantic observation for missing attribute

tests.precondition: source_paths length differs from number of sealed items
tests.expected: Reject canonical construction before any canonical manifest is committed; preserve immutable original files

tests.precondition: source_paths are permuted/reversed relative to worker monotonic path sequence, or duplicated
tests.expected: Reject rather than silently attribute source values to wrong fields

tests.precondition: Path traversal, non-DMI root, unsupported/secret attribute, malformed separator or path suffix
tests.expected: Reject; no speculative path normalization or acceptance based on raw bytes

tests.precondition: Evidence artifact identifier or ordinal does not match receipt item index, or evidence belongs to another run
tests.expected: Reject same-run binding; do not publish altered canonical contents

tests.precondition: Parser called without source_path or with undecodable raw content
tests.expected: Attributed SourceParseError only when actual parser invoked; raw evidence remains sealed

tests.precondition: Empty-string DMI value, optional missing value and bounded non-text blob
tests.expected: Do not fabricate product identity; preserve original; limited parser errors require real invocation

scope_limits: Does not establish source path authenticity against an attacker able to rewrite trusted G5-03 receipt before validation
Does not normalize other sysfs families or close CP-04 integrity findings
Does not establish G5-04 gate acceptance, public-output privacy verification, or Bodhi host validation
